description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Printer_HTMLDefinition' which extends the 'HTMLPurifier_Printer' base class. It contains methods to render detailed HTML documentation for HTML definitions, including doctype information, environment settings, content sets, and element info, primarily for debugging or development purposes within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_HTMLDefinition
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering detailed HTML documentation of an HTMLDefinition object, including doctype, environment, content sets, and element info, aimed at debugging or documentation.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method that orchestrates rendering all sections: doctype, environment, content sets, and info, returning the assembled HTML string.

methods.name: renderDoctype
methods.description: Generates an HTML table displaying the doctype's name, XML status, and associated modules.

methods.name: renderEnvironment
methods.description: Generates an HTML table documenting environmental information such as parent fragment, block wrapper, global attributes, tag transforms, and attribute transforms.

methods.name: renderContentSets
methods.description: Generates a table listing all content sets in the HTML definition.

methods.name: renderInfo
methods.description: Renders a comprehensive table of element info, including allowed tags, inline content, excludes, attribute transforms, auto-closure, allowed attributes, required attributes, and children.

methods.name: renderChildren
methods.description: Renders allowed children for an element, including special handling for chameleon and custom types.
